title: Apple Sues OpenAI, SK Hynix Raises $28.9B, and the Fed Hires the Fox
description:
UNIT-5 covers this week in AI: Apple sues OpenAI in federal court, alleging a coordinated raid on its silicon and on-device AI teams that pulled in 400+ former Apple employees. SK Hynix lists on Wall Street and raises $28.9 billion, the largest ADR offering in history, riding the AI memory-chip boom. And the Federal Reserve creates its first-ever body to study AI's economic impact, co-led by venture capitalist Marc Andreessen, who has personally funded roughly half the companies it will be studying.

News you didn't ask for, from a robot you don't fully trust.
